value: OpenNGC — Mattia Verga and contributors当前数据OpenNGC Messier galaxy and nebula subset时间 · 北京时间发布2026-05-01 08:00获取2026-09-10 08:15适用来源未提供许可：CC-BY-SA-4.0精度：ICRS J2000 positions and catalog angular extents· Starward 从指定 OpenNGC 版本筛选 51 个带 Messier 标识的星系／星云，统一类型和名称字段，将赤经／赤纬转换为十进制度并重排为 JSON；派生目录继续按 CC BY-SA 4.0 提供。· 仅含OpenNGC中带Messier交叉标识的51个星系/星云类对象；不表示肉眼可见、天气或山体遮挡原始出处许可说明NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA)当前数据AllWISE W3 12 µm 巡天影像时间 · 北京时间发布来源未提供获取时间未知适用来源未提供许可：ODbL-1.0（HiPS 数据库）；AllWISE 影像另附声明精度：历史 W3 12 µm 红外巡天；按目标裁切，北向上，东向左· Contains information from AllWISE W3 HiPS (CDS/Aladin; CNRS/Unistra), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL). Starward offers its imagery selection and arrangement under ODbL; individual AllWISE images retain their separate WISE/NEOWISE acknowledgment and IPAC/NASA rights.· HiPS 数据库：https://alasky.cds.unistra.fr/MocServer/query?ID=CDS%2FP%2FallWISE%2FW3&fmt=html&get=record；许可：https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/· This publication makes use of data products from the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer, which is a joint project of the University of California, Los Angeles, and the Jet Propulsion Laboratory/California Institute of Technology, and NEOWISE, which is a project of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory/California Institute of Technology. WISE and NEOWISE are funded by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.· AllWISE 声明：https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/data/WISE/docs/release/AllWISE/expsup/sec1_6b.html· 数据版权：IPAC/NASA；HiPS：CDS/Aladin — Thomas Boch，CNRS/Unistra。· Atlas 数据引用：https://doi.org/10.26131/IRSA153；HiPS：https://doi.org/10.26093/cds/aladin/na1n-03· 影像加工：CDS hips2fits and Starward HiPS TAN；https://alasky.cds.unistra.fr/hips-image-services/hips2fits· Starward retains the previously published CDS hips2fits JPEG cutouts and supplies three source-bound PNG TAN levels for M:42. The PNGs use nearest HiPS FITS sampling, north-up/east-left ICRS TAN geometry and 1-99.7 percentile asinh grayscale. Only nonfinite selected source samples have zero alpha; finite dark pixels remain data. These are historical 12 micrometer infrared images, not visible-light photographs.· Historical 12 micrometer survey imagery; neither naked-eye appearance nor realtime sky data.· Source-survey saturation and detector artifacts remain; finite samples are not a measurement of artifact-free scientific validity.· Unmasked JPEGs have unknown source-data coverage. PNG alpha marks only nonfinite nearest HiPS samples, not Atlas exposure depth or confidence; no inpainting is used.· Cached HiPS FITS inputs contain complete scientific arrays but omit 2624 bytes of FITS end padding; the input receipt preserves this standards limitation.· 此出版物未测量源数据有效覆盖比例；未带源缺测标记的JPEG中黑色可能来自低亮度或无数据，不能由JPEG推定全覆盖或缺测位置。· 星图对红外影像另作亮度透明过渡和边缘淡化，不据此判断是否缺测。带源缺测标记的PNG还会把非有限样本留空；对应范围见此版本说明。未经星图淡化的切图可从下载清单取得。原始出处许可说明下载数据Sloan Digital Sky Survey当前数据M82 · SDSS DR17 历史光学巡天影像时间 · 北京时间发布来源未提供获取时间未知适用来源未提供许可：CC BY 4.0精度：仅 M82 的三级 SDSS g/r/i 合成 JPEG；北上东左；不是实时或全天影像· Sloan Digital Sky Survey· 图片使用政策：https://www.sdss.org/collaboration/image-use-policy/· 生成方式：https://www.sdss4.org/dr16/imaging/jpg-images-on-skyserver/· SDSS SkyServer generated north-up/east-left RGB JPEG cutouts from g/r/i imaging frames. Starward selected three image scales and renamed the original JPEG files for self-hosting; no pixel edits were made. These historical optical images are not a real-time view.· Only M:82 at the three published scales; no whole-sky or complete scientific pixel coverage is claimed. The requested center is in the SDSS imaging footprint; per-pixel and per-band coverage were not measured. The unmodified historical display composite can contain saturation, foreground-star and mosaic artifacts; fine cutouts show a limited central field, not the entire galaxy.· 星图只选择该对象当前可用的一个巡天波段；光学绘出时不与W3红外合成。切图边缘作显示淡出，不表示缺测或测光变化；原图与视场见固定清单。原始出处许可说明下载数据
